name: ensoniqplaystream
description: ensoniqplay(1) M2 streamed playback: a 44100-byte PCM (2 s of 440 Hz sine at 22050 Hz, 8-bit unsigned) exceeds the 32 KB one-oscillator wavetable, so the tool takes the streaming path -- it holds the file in an mm_alloc'd pool and feeds a 512 B DOC-RAM double-buffer under the sound IRQ (oscillator B free-runs the buffer; a silent rate-locked timer oscillator A raises a refill IRQ each 256-byte half).  'streaming' proves the size dispatch chose the IRQ path; 'finished after 1' (100-199 ticks; 44100/22050 = 2.0 s = ~120 ticks) proves the IRQ engine actually clocked through the whole file at the programmed rate and the end-of-stream drain fired.  The streamed-sample static (docs/history/audits/ntpplay-streaming.md) may perturb the audio in emulation but not the timing.  The story stages at test time.
